messages:
Maya (partnerships): Quick thread  we need a formal rule for attribution weighting when SIs + Marketplace both touch the same account. Current disputes are messy.
Jen (SI-lead): Agree. Proposal: assign primary credit to the first-touch channel, secondary credit to co-sell participants. Weighting: 70/30 by default (first-touch 70%, co-sell 30%).
Derek (salesops): That works but we need edge rules. If AE converts during SI claim window, override to 50/50 unless SI did >2 technical presales sessions.
Marco (marketplace): For Marketplace referrals, make them special: if listing generated the lead (UTM present), Marketplace gets at least 25% even if SI did demo. Add `Listing_Id__c` to opps.
Sophia (AE): Practical ask: show attribution on the opp page and in pipeline reports. Can we add a field `Partner_Attribution_Split__c` that stores JSON? (or simple CSV).
Derek (salesops): Prefer CSV to avoid nested fields. e.g., `SI:30,Marketplace:25,AE:45`. We'll store in `Partner_Attribution__c`. RevOps can parse.
Partnerbot: Note: opp 006543 flagged with duplicate partner claims.
Maya (partnerships): Conflict rules: first-claim timestamp wins if within claim window. If overlap and claim-timestamps identical (rare), Partnerships triage and assign provisional split 50/50 until resolved.
Jen (SI-lead): Add presales session counter: `SI_Presales_Sessions__c`. If >=2, SI gets +10% credit from first-touch share (capped at 90%).
Lina (legal): Reminder: any customer-facing co-branded assets must be approved. We're adding a clause to partner agreements to allow Redwood to reference joint deals for case studies unless partner opts out.
Sophia (AE): For hardware SIs, cycles are long. Suggest special cadence: expand claim window to 12 business days and allow retroactive attribution up to close date if partner provided hardware integration proof.
Marco (marketplace): Let's make a flag `Hardware_Integrated__c` for opps and apply the extended window automatically. Marketplace listing form should include an "integration evidence" upload field.
Derek (salesops): Actionable items: 1) Add `Partner_Attribution__c`, `SI_Presales_Sessions__c`, `Listing_Id__c`, `Hardware_Integrated__c` to SFDC. 2) Workflow for auto-splits on creation. 3) Dispute queue `partner-claims`. I'll open the Jira ticket.
Maya (partnerships): Metrics: Partnerships wants a weekly report of top partner-influenced opps (by $) and attribution changes. Can RevOps run `Partner_Attribution__c` delta weekly.
Derek (salesops): Yes. I'll schedule a weekly report and Slack webhook to #partnerships-reports.
Jen (SI-lead): One more ops note: when SI does >3 technical sessions and we still lose, tag `SI_Lost_Post_Presale__c = TRUE` so we can do partner health review.
Maya (partnerships): Good call. Also add a short-runbook for common disputes and required evidence (email timestamp, demo recording, integration ticket).
Lina (legal): I'll draft the partner clause about attribution audits and evidence retention (90 days).
Marco (marketplace): Marketplace Bot: validation alert  new listing missing `integration_evidence` for partner 1129.
Partnerbot: Created ticket PARTNER-203 for SFDC fields and automation.
Sophia (AE): Sounds solid. Can we pilot these rules for 6 weeks, then iterate?
Maya (partnerships): Yes  pilot start next Monday. I'll post SOP and sample opp examples later today. Thanks everyone.
